biotools.summary: transcriptogramer is an R package for transcriptional analysis using transcriptograms, a method that projects expression values onto ordered proteins to analyze transcriptomes and identify altered gene sets. The package supports genome-wide gene expression profile analysis and is available on Bioconductor.
